description.value: The study examined whether the first behavioral symptom of bvFTD, apathy or disinhibition, was associated with later neuropsychological profiles and patterns of brain atrophy, and tested multivariate classification of the patient subgroups.

design.value: A cross-sectional comparison of healthy controls and two bvFTD subgroups defined retrospectively by their first symptom, with neuropsychological testing, 3T structural MRI/VBM, brain-behavior correlations, and multivariate classification analyses performed approximately three years after disease debut.

spans.text: Here, we evaluated the neuropsychological and neuroanatomical correlates (measured at an average of 3 years after the report of the first symptom) in a group of controls and two groups of bvFTD patients (debuting with apathy or disinhibition).
